name: SDN Host P2P Discovery
description: Capability node for the host p2p_read discovery hostcalls (typed contracts 1.0; gateway loops G.2-G.4). Each method takes the $APR routing decision from foundation/http-route discover on "decision", makes one SDS $PIV hostcall and answers the $APR (verbatim when served, with STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE when refused) beside a typed body for foundation/http-respond: peers_snapshot (peers_list, peer_get) -> p2p.peers_snapshot -> "peers" $NST (peer rows; identity fields from each peer's stored $EPM); standards_snapshot (standards) -> p2p.standards_snapshot -> "notices" $PNV (one verdict per newest signed $PNM per peer and standard); pnm_history (pnm_history) -> p2p.pnm_history -> "notices" $PNV (the peer's signed publications, newest first, attributed by signature on the host); latest_dataset (latest_dataset) -> p2p.latest_dataset -> "availability" $DAV + the batch on the standard's "<code>_records" port, or (DELIVER Ref, asked unless the request wants JSON) the host's body reference on DAV.BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE. $NST and $PNV carry a content ETAG; each PNVEntry carries the received $PNM verbatim (PNM). A decision that already carries a STATUS, or a route the method does not own, passes on with no hostcall (the latter as 404 no-route). Hostcall failures answer 502 host-failed; a peerId or standard longer than the hostcall record holds answers 400 invalid-parameter, never truncated. No JSON and no base64 anywhere.

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host discovery snapshots (peerstore + DHT + EPM registry + stored PNMs) as SDS $PIV hostcalls; node.peerId (ungated) names the verifier.
clock.now stamps NST.GENERATED_AT / PNV.GENERATED_AT_MS (0 when the clock is refused). Built-in on the Go node; capability-gated on the SDK hosts.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $APR (SDS API Request): METHOD, PATH, ROUTE, PARAMETERS (peerId, limit, standard), IF_NONE_MATCH, ACCEPT.

inputPorts.description: One $APR routing decision from foundation/http-route discover. Served routes: peers_list, peer_get (param peerId). An APR that already carries a STATUS, or names another route, passes on with no hostcall.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $APR passed on beside the body (or refused) so foundation/http-respond has both the request and the outcome.

outputPorts.description: The decision: the input $APR VERBATIM when the request is served; otherwise a copy with STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE set (400 invalid-parameter, 404 no-route / peer-unknown / no-publications / not-published / not-served, 502 host-failed, 503 dataset-unavailable).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $NST (SDS Node Status Record): one NSTNode per peer the host reports (peer_get: the one peer) - PEER_ID, AGENT_VERSION, MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS (peer_addresses), STANDARDS (peer_standards), IS_ONLINE (connected), IS_SELF, SOURCE "connected" for a live connection (the host states no config/pinned provenance), and from the peer's stored $EPM profile DN, ORGANIZATION (LEGAL_NAME), SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY / ENCRYPTION_PUBLIC_KEY (KEYS by KEY_TYPE); SOURCE_PEER_ID = the host's SELF; GENERATED_AT = clock.now; ETAG = weak FNV-1a 64 over the record built without its GENERATED_AT stamp and ETAG (a content tag: the same content keeps its tag on every call; the responder answers 304 on it).

outputPorts.description: The node's peer board as one $NST (absent when the decision is refused).

methods.description: Serves peers_list / peer_get through one p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall (SDS $PIV: P2pParams {PEER_ID for peer_get, DELIVER Inline} -> P2pSummary, lists peers / peer_addresses / peer_standards, raw records = the stored $EPM profiles) and answers the $APR decision beside one $NST. peer_get for a peer the node does not know answers 404 peer-unknown. BATCHING: the "decision" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are declarative only), so a second decision frame in one invocation is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count, rather than answered from another request's hostcall or destroyed (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $PNV (SDS Publication Verification): per notice PUBLISHER_PEER_ID, RECEIVED_FROM_PEER_ID (the gossip-delivering peer), STANDARD, SCHEMA_NAME, FILE_ID, FILE_NAME, CID, PUBLISHED_AT_MS, SIGNATURE_TYPE, SIGNATURE and PUBLISHER_KEY (hex-decoded), SIGNATURE_VERIFIED, ATTRIBUTION (host "signature": Direct when the publisher delivered it, Relayed otherwise, OwnNode for this node; "gossip": Unattributed), KEY_SOURCE (epm-directory: IdentityRecord), REASON when not verified, PNM = the received $PNM frame verbatim (size-prefixed, from raw records at PNM_INDEX) so a reader can verify the signature itself; VERIFIER_PEER_ID, GENERATED_AT_MS (clock.now); ETAG = weak FNV-1a 64 over the record built without its GENERATED_AT stamp and ETAG (a content tag: the same content keeps its tag on every call; the responder answers 304 on it).

outputPorts.description: The verdicts as one $PNV (absent when the decision is refused).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $DAV (SDS Dataset Availability): STANDARD, SCHEMA_NAME, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, KNOWN, AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE_REASON (NotPublished when unknown; not-pinned / not-materialized: NotHeld; stale, unverified, not-entitled), SELF_PUBLISHED, PINNED, FRESH, BATCH_ID, RECORD_COUNT, BYTE_COUNT, PARTS, PUBLISHED_AT_MS, the newest notice (PNM_CID, PNM_FILE_ID, PNM_PUBLISHED_AT_MS, PNM_SIGNATURE_VERIFIED), PUBLISHER_PEER_ID (the requested peer), ETAG W/"fnv1a64-<host hash>", BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE when the batch stays with the host (out-of-band delivery).

outputPorts.description: The dataset's availability as one $DAV, beside a served batch and beside the 404 / 503 refusals (absent for 400 / 502 and pass-through).

methods.description: Serves /peers/{peerId}/{standard}/latest through one p2p.latest_dataset hostcall (SDS $PIV: P2pParams {PEER_ID, STANDARD, DELIVER Ref, or Inline when the APR ACCEPT is Json} -> P2pLatestDataset + raw stream). The host serves the newest publication batch whose signed PNM verifies AND whose content is materialized locally, gated by the OPT-IN gateway.pin config (a node's own publications are always servable); never a silent proxy fetch. Served: the decision verbatim, the $DAV (AVAILABLE) and the batch on the standard's <code>_records port. Unknown lane: 404 not-published + $DAV. Known but not servable (REASON): 503 dataset-unavailable + $DAV carrying the newest PNM pointer. A standard with no record port here: 404 not-served + $DAV. Delivery: a host that honours Ref keeps the batch and answers its BodyRef, which rides DAV.BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE with no *_records frame (http-respond answers it out of band through the $HTR body reference); a JSON request asks Inline, because the responder must render the bytes; a host that ignores Ref answers inline as before. BATCHING: the "decision" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind (maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are declarative only), so a second decision frame in one invocation is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count, rather than answered from another request's hostcall or destroyed (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method makes one p2p_read hostcall and answers it on the calling thread; the host runs independent invocations in parallel and this module creates no threads.
